Committees & Student Welfare

Know where different kinds of student and academic concerns belong.

Medical College

Medical CollegeMBBSMD/MSDepartments & HODsLibrary & FacilitiesLeadershipCommitteesStudent GuideStudent SupportTeaching HospitalContactDisclosures & Approvals

The brochure lists the committees below. For current membership, formal complaint procedures or a time-sensitive concern, contact the college office rather than relying on a general web enquiry.

Student Welfare Committee

Student needs, access to campus resources, recreation and welfare.

Student Mental Health & Wellness Committee

Emotional wellbeing and coordination with mentors, psychiatrists and psychologists.

Student Grievance Redressal Committee

A route for concerns about academic, administrative and campus matters.

Anti-Ragging Committee & Flying Squad

Prevention, reporting and investigation of ragging concerns.

Internal Complaints Committee

Workplace and campus sexual-harassment concerns, with confidentiality and the applicable formal process.

Gender Harassment Committee

Gender equity, sensitisation and concerns about discrimination.

Hostel Advisory Committee

Hostel maintenance, living conditions, security and dining arrangements.

College Disciplinary Committee

Professional conduct and enquiries into reported misconduct.

College Council

Coordination between the Principal and department heads.

Curriculum Committee

Course planning, integration, assessment and the CBME curriculum.

Anti-Drug Committee

Substance-use awareness and campus prevention measures.

Medical Education Unit

Faculty development and teaching methods.

Institutional Ethics Committee

Ethical review of human biomedical research.

Institutional Animal Ethics Committee

Review of research involving animals.

Scientific & Research Advisory Committee

Review and support for student and faculty research.

Hospital Infection Control Committee

Infection prevention and antibiotic stewardship.

Pharmacovigilance Committee

Adverse drug reaction monitoring and reporting.

Hospital Security & Safety Committee

Campus safety, access control and preparedness.

Mortality & Death Audit Committee

Clinical case reviews and death audits.

College Disciplinary Committee

The brochure lists Dr. Rohit Dixit as Chairperson, Dr. P. Suhasini as Vice-Chairperson and Dr. S. Pradeep Reddy as Member-Secretary.
